html:
Greetings, Agents.


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

In celebration of the spring season, 
Mutants and Inhumans have stepped out 
for a springtime outing in our latest patch.


New Tier-4 Advancements and Uniforms have been added for 
Stryfe, an Omega-level mutant who believes mutants should rule Earth, 
and Crystal, an Inhuman with the power to manipulate the elements 
who strives for peaceful relations between humans and Inhumans.

 

Agents, please download the 3/17 (Tue) patch 
to check out their new skills and enhanced power!

 


■ 3/17 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 3/18 (Wed) 6:00 (UTC+0), 3/17 (Tue) 23:00 (PDT)
* Maintenance is scheduled for 3/18 (Wed) 1:00 – 6:00 (UTC+0), 3/17 (Tue) 18:00 - 23:00 (PDT), 

and the game will be unavailable during this time.
Please check the notice below for more details.
[Go to → 3/17 Maintenance Notice]

 

[3/18 (Wed) 6:53 (UTC+0), 3/17 (Tue) 23:53 (PDT) added]
The patch has been completed as of 3/18 (Wed) 6:53 (UTC+0), 3/17 (Tue) 23:53 (PDT).
Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 


▣ Two New Uniforms


Two new Uniforms, Crystal <Spring Lady>, 
and Stryfe <The Tyrant of Spring> have been added.
* The two new Uniforms can be purchased after the 3/17 Patch data has been applied.
* New Uniforms are available for purchase during the Event period.
* Seasonal Uniforms may be available for purchase again 
after the event has been over through similar events or packages.
* A 10% Agent Supplies discount coupon will be distributed in celebration of Spring 2026.
- Coupon acquisition and available period: 
3/17 (Tue) 15:00 – 3/31 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
3/17 (Tue) 8:00 – 3/31 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)


▶ Crystal <Spring Lady>
After the 3/18 Patch - 4/3 (Fri) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 3/17 Patch - 4/3 (Fri) 7:59 (PDT)
- How to Purchase: Exchange for 2026 Spring Token Shop Tokens in the Event Token Shop
- 2026 Spring Token Shop Tokens can be acquired until 3/31 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0) / 7:59 (PDT) through purchasing Event Products sold in-game and at the Agent Supplies and through other methods.
* Please check if the token is included before purchasing any product.


▶ You can also obtain 2026 Spring Token Shop Tokens from the Agent Supplies products,
and products that can grant these tokens are marked in the upper-right corner.

 

 

Sale Period:
3/17 (Tue) 15:00 - 3/31 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0)
3/17 (Tue) 8:00 - 3/31 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
Please visit the Agent Supplies during this period to check them out.
[Go to Agent Supplies]


▶ Stryfe <The Tyrant of Spring>
After the 3/18 Patch - 3/31 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 3/17 Patch - 3/31 (Tie) 7:59 (PDT)
- How to Purchase: Crystal purchase (Discount event will not be applied.)

 

* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ Crystal & Stryfe Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancements are now available for Crystal and Stryfe, 
Stryfe will exert even greater force to deny his status as a clone, 
while Crystal continues her efforts to improve the social perception of Inhumans.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Other Product Related Notice

 

1. Some of the package products visible only to specific Agents or under certain conditions have been improved.
- Event Period: After the 3/17 maintenance – Until further notice
- Target Products: Native Character Tier-3 Advancement Relay #1–2
- The product name has been changed to "Native Character Tier-3 Upgrade Relay," and some components within the packs have been updated. 

 

 

2. The ‘Potential Realization’ system is scheduled to be improved in the upcoming April regular update.
Please refer to the separate notice for more details.
[Go to → April Update: Potential Realization Improvement Notice]

We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
